canonical.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Marcon

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Marcon
siblings.summary: Distinctive sleeps within a 30-min taxi of Régis & Jacques Marcon — troglodyte rooms next door, yurts in the same hamlet, a heritage manor, plus fallbacks if the 3-star books out.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Marcon
siblings.summary: Half-day and full-day options around Restaurant Régis et Jacques Marcon in Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid: hikes, WWII memorial, hot-air-balloon history, steam train, safari park, cheese and markets — split for Saturday before dinner and Sunday before departure.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Marcon
siblings.summary: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid is a rural plateau — no IT conferences are scheduled within 30 km for the rest of 2026. The closest real tech events sit 50–140 km away in Saint-Étienne, Le Puy-en-Velay, Valence, and Lyon.

sources.title: Hôtel Régis & Jacques Marcon — official
sources.claim: Hôtel Régis & Jacques Marcon is 4-star Relais & Châteaux with 10 troglodyte rooms (9×50m², 1×95m²) on the same Larsiallas compound as the gastronomic restaurant, with a salt-treated pool reserved for guests.

sources.title: Les Maisons Marcon — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Les Maisons Marcon is a Relais & Châteaux member operating multiple lodging properties in Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid alongside the gastronomic restaurant.

sources.title: Les Maisons Marcon — directions / addresses
sources.claim: The Marcon properties are split between three village streets.

sources.title: Le Clos des Cimes — official
sources.claim: Le Clos des Cimes is a 3-star Marcon-operated stone house offering 30m² rooms and 38m² junior suites with spa access included.

sources.title: Hôtel La Découverte — official
sources.claim: Hôtel La Découverte is a 3-star Marcon-operated property with 18m² rooms renovated in 2015.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hotel Régis et Jacques Marcon review
sources.claim: Hotel rates 4.8/5 across 125 reviews; obligatory for the 3-Michelin meal.

sources.title: Boutique Marcon — booking
sources.claim: Marcon double room from €430 HT; breakfast €30/pp; 6-month rolling reservation window.

sources.title: Chambres Chatelard — official
sources.claim: Four suites in village centre at 16bis rue du Vivarais; hammam included; from €130.

sources.title: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid — Chambres Chatelard listing
sources.claim: Chatelard chambres d'hôtes are Clévacances-labelled, four spacious modern suites in the heart of the village.

sources.title: Les Bruyères de Gaschon — official
sources.claim: Insolite stays — Finnish barrel, gypsy caravan, Auvergne cabin — at lieu-dit Gaschon; seasonal.
